mechanism: Measured from tests/unit/test_stream_path_full_frame_compare.sh on stream_path_full_frame_tb. Per-stage cycle accounting via stub_busy/fs_wr_reset/fs_swap phase transitions. Product hold backpressure is unconditional (walker stalls on stub FETCH). 2026-04 sink serial-IQ redesign: dequant+hadamard are cycle-iterative (1 mul lane, ~16cy each) plus 16cy APPLY_PX; I-frame paint rises (~2150 cy/MB frame0 real-ref). Ratchet retuned from serial-IQ measure (cycles_total≈3.71e6, cyc/mb≈1031, parse_cavlc≈723). Deblock/DDR product write remain NOT IMPLEMENTED.
